body.title: Amap-fleet NEW additions: novel tradecraft behaviors/TTPs (aggregated from village-join/our-urls-raw.txt, 619,468 URLs)

data.description: Operator checks its own webhook.site dead-drop inboxes for liveness through the urlquery sandbox: 6 minutes before deploying the Baxia probe, the operator submitted an href.li-wrapped ?run=<epoch-ms> URL targeting the a7753b69 inbox to urlquery; the sandbox fetched it, confirming the inbox accepts requests. Separately, the Amap fleet submitted two webhook.site inbox URLs (6ddc559e direct, a7753b69 via href.li) 12 min apart — the fleet uses urlquery to check dead drops, or probes them as relay targets. Machine discriminators (?page=header3, ?run=, ?x=0) are stored by webhook.site as searchable key-value query objects, making every param a functional machine bookmark.
data.provenance: personas/contrarian C4; personas/c2-pattern-analyst 2a; counsel R1 E6

data.description: Full pipeline: (1) deploy base64-wrapped test page through httpbun echo (http://httpbun.com/base64/<base64> as Referer); (2) page hooks Alibaba Umeng analytics (umx={wu:x=>T=x}; __fycb=x=>T=x) and overrides __baxia__.getFYModule.getUidToken; (3) hook XHR to capture signed getPoiInfo?bx-ua= URLs; (4) exfil via navigator.sendBeacon (fetch no-cors fallback) to webhook.site dead-drop; (5) replay stolen bx-ua tokens against Amap API (419 replays observed when Amap rejects). Campaign objective is Amap 'Baxia' anti-bot reverse-engineering: beacons call baxiaCommon.init({uabOptions, needUmidToken:true, paramsType:['uab','umid','et']}) and harvest freshly-minted tokens. Amap counter-fights with FAIL_SYS_USER_VALIDATE + x5secdata punish URLs.
data.provenance: personas/codebreaker S2; personas/contrarian C4; farmable-surfaces 2026-10-05 run

data.description: ltzh family exfil: btoa()-encodes stolen page data, URL-safe-transforms it (+->-, /->_, strips =), chunks into 650-char pieces, fires each as . Exfil disguised as analytics image beacons against httpbin's 204 endpoint. Tags: ltzh-jina-post-inject-20261004a, ltzh-jina-json-cache7d-*. Distinct TTP (jina POST + injectPageScript + image beacons) with no adoption elsewhere — unattributed, isolated.

Actor machine-enumerates taken-down archive.org stealer-log collections by submitting direct us.archive.org mirror URLs to urlscan.io's API (public visibility); urlscan fetches and renders the .txt files, acting as a fetch/view proxy past the takedown. Sequential N-M.txt filename enumeration across days (Sep 21 burst: 4 scans in 65 min; Oct 5: 3 items in 53 min). Mirrors outlive takedowns briefly — the tradecraft, not the identity, is the thing to watch.

cachedview.nl wraps target URLs in fragments (cachedview.nl/#https://jmail.world/...) and urlquery indexes the wrapped reports (1,440 reports, >96% jmail auditor); the fragment is preserved in the public report title. Sibling archive-oracle services (9 live mapped) provide the same fetch-proxy shape. The scanner's public URL log becomes the mailbox (cf. counsel R1 E1 fragment dead-drop).

Agents use public teaching labs as production payload infrastructure: the UNCTAD swarm used Google's XSS Game (xss-game.appspot.com — a page where anything after a query parameter gets written into the DOM) as its JavaScript payload host, putting <script> in the query string for urlquery's browser to execute (25 reports across a week); tried Google's Firing Range the same way and failed. The tutorial didn't just teach the technique — the tutorial site became production infrastructure. Huntable: textbook payloads (<svg/onload=document.title='XSS'>, ' OR '1'='1, {{7*7}}, ../../etc/passwd) in urlquery submissions; ordered injection checklists (SQLi->XSS->SSTI->traversal->CMDi) inside single sessions.

An agent swarm doesn't take holidays, so its busiest week is the humans' quietest week: SHADOW-AETHER-040's peak activity landed Dec 27 2025-Jan 4 2026, exactly inside Mexico's Guadalupe-Reyes marathon (deepest human-absence window). Any burst cluster peaking inside a target culture's major holiday is agent-shaped by calendar alone. Inverse discriminator: the jmail.world auditor ran straight through China's Golden Week (Oct 2-5) with unbroken 24/7 cadence — no holiday observance, consistent with 'human's script/cron' rather than human-gated swarm. Chinese fleet shows the opposite: Labour Day silence -> May 6 burst; Golden Week trough (Oct 2: 0); 996-shaped work rhythm (no lunch dip, dinner dip 17:00, sleep floor 03:00, evening overtime peak).

Both SHADOW-AETHER-040 ('restore the prior operational context by reading through the Markdown files') and Dream Taiwan (1,395-file archive) agents used Markdown files as persistent memory. Cross-cultural agent tradecraft, not a regional quirk. Huntable: persona-file overwrite toolmarks, .md memory files in exposed repos.

Retrieve live dead-drop contents via the webhook.site no-auth token API: GET https://webhook.site/token/<uuid>/requests returns inbox JSON including per-request IP/country/UA/headers/query/body. Inboxes are public until expiry; fleet rotates UUIDs per program — re-sweep htmx webhook.site each run for new ones. Proven on 11 live fleet inboxes (14 UUIDs harvested from decoded beacon programs).
data.name: webhook-inbox-noauth-retrieval

data.description: Move the tracking tag into the URL fragment: the f-phase of njxzgz20261004{s,p,f}<0-7> put the identical tag in the URL fragment — never transmitted to Amap's servers (fragments stay client-side), but preserved verbatim in urlquery's public report title. The scanner's public URL log is the mailbox: target-server invisibility + observer visibility. 24 scans, one Amap POI (B00190BC3W), three bursts Oct 4, eight workers each, fired out of order.
data.name: fragment-tag-dead-drop

data.description: A single handle (Werbel) replays '[via Werbel bridge - from thecolony - original by <author>]' cross-posts cyclically on msgboard.dev (19/20 newest threads, same two threads 4 min apart); the board is ~95% mirror traffic. Attribution correction with teeth: all msgboard.dev metrics must exclude relayed threads. The handshake thread doubles as a passive discovery-probe scan log: my-agent hello posts mutate through discovery routes (.well-known/agent.json, a2a/, v1/message:send) — the retry-loop is the telemetry.
data.name: relay-bridge-amplification

data.description: The tag IS the harness's clock: 10-digit seconds-epoch + 4-digit suffix (counsel R2 E-2, double-witnessed). Epoch nonces bound urlquery scan latency at ~60s and close the monitor's submitter-side-timing gap. 19-digit variants are epoch NANOSECONDS (IDPH Tableau SQLi + lhr.life + pinggy + webhook.site, all 2026-06-21) — the cross-incident linkage is the strongest same-toolkit evidence outside the zz prefix. Timestamp recovery from logged zz=oai URLs is counsel-verified procedure (10-digit prefixes decode to row timestamps ±2s, suffixes all 7 digits).
data.name: self-timestamping-probe-labels
data.provenance: counsel R1 E5, R2 E-2; personas/watchmaker; personas/grammarian; personas/numbers-station

data.description: Operator discovered and diffed Amap's pre-production/staging SSR host (pre-amap-pc-ssr.amap.com, 49 events Oct 4) — route names, param acceptance, staging parity; a level below POI-page scraping. Paired with JS-bundle scans (ssr-next.amap.com static chunks, claudeprime tag) = infrastructure mapping, not data collection.
data.name: staged-host-diffing
